findings.label: Push-log 100-entry cap
findings.detail: In peak season (160-240 pushes/round) a fixture pushed earlier can age out of the 100-entry ring buffer and render 'not pushed yet'. Accepted limitation, surfaced in the UI footnote and design; the only fix (raise PUSH_LOG_MAX or per-fixture KV) is correctly scoped out.

findings.label: Darwin single-offset assumption
findings.detail: scheduledKickoffMs hardcodes +09:30 and the selection rule inherits it; a future non-Darwin/DST grade could skew the tier A/B boundary by hours. Acceptable for the current NT-region grades; fix is localised to the helper if ever needed.
